scope: Pinned public source and official published JAR structure/member-reference inspection. No installed runtime, build or exploit testing; method references do not establish complete control-flow equivalence.
aoa_design_requirements: Server-authoritative charge transfer with bounded request inputs and an exact stack/slot identity
Per-projectile immutable effect provenance; never gate unrelated outstanding projectiles solely by shooter UUID
Separate cosmetic animation length from native shot cadence and resource success
Cleanup pending effects on expiry, logout, dimension/session change and cancellation
Use explicit casting context and guaranteed state restoration; avoid temporary player relocation if an API can express impact origin
Cache optional integration lookup and assembly definitions; measure actual tick cost before performance claims
